steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper.

steps.action: Ten seconds. That’s all Jacob had before the storm’s first wave slammed into the rocks below. He raced up the spiral stairs of the old lighthouse, heart pounding, as rain lashed the windows. At the lantern room’s threshold, he re-lit the lamp’s wick with trembling hands. The beam cut through the gathering gloom, a steadfast eye piercing the black swell. Outside, a ship’s horn blared in distress. Seconds later, its captain spotted the glow and steered away from the jagged shoals. Jacob exhaled, drenched but triumphant—ten seconds had saved countless lives.
